messages:
Anna S: Heads-up — Acme POC hit a blocker when trying to pin owl-3b:v2 in eu-west1. They're getting an immediate MODEL_NOT_FOUND error when calling /v1/outputs with model=owl-3b:v2. They need a pinned version for eval parity.
Michael (SE): Can you paste the exact error blob from their logs?
Anna S: paste: {
  "error": "MODEL_NOT_FOUND",
  "model": "owl-3b:v2",
  "region": "eu-west1",
  "request_id": "req_01FZ..."
}
Michael (SE): Thanks. Quick check against our catalog — looks like v2 was removed from eu-west1 last month due to a kernel incompatibility on older GPU nodes. cc @eng_oncall
eng_oncall: Confirmed. owl-3b:v2 was deprecated in eu-west1 (kernel mismatch with our optimized kernels). Options: 1) pin to owl-3b:v1 in eu-west1 (behavior/perf differences), 2) run in eu-central1 where v2 still exists, or 3) use a compatible quantized variant (owl-3b-q:v2) if their eval accepts quantized outputs.
Anna S: They explicitly require the same v2 artifact for apples-to-apples evals and cannot switch to quantized. Region change is painful for their data residency. Is there a way to restore v2 in eu-west1 for the POC?
eng_oncall: Short-term workaround: infra can create an alias on the catalog so requests for owl-3b:v2 in eu-west1 are routed to the nearest compatible variant (effectively a rollforward). This is an infra operation and touches routing/audit; estimate ~48h to implement and needs sign-off. Longer-term: replicate v2 artifact to eu-west1 which is a larger capacity job.
Josh (sales): Clarify cost/impact — will the alias/lab routing incur extra fees for the customer or change the billing meter?
linda_sec: Also flag: any aliasing that makes model artifacts accessible in a new region will need a quick security review (logs, KMS). For hosted POC we can probably do a narrow-scoped exception, but for Private/VPC we need SOC approval.
Michael (SE): Proposal for Acme: 1) Offer pin-to-v1 as a stopgap if acceptable. 2) Offer a 48-hour alias rollforward lab (no charge) so they can finish evaluations with the effective v2 behavior — we absorb infra ops cost for the trial. 3) Open an INFRA ticket to schedule region replication if they want permanent pinning.
Anna S: Good plan. Can eng_oncall open the ticket and give an ETA? I need to let Acme know ASAP (they're demoing on Tuesday).
eng_oncall: Opening INFRA-8723 now (routing alias for owl-3b:v2 in eu-west1). Estimated ETA for lab alias: ~48 hours, ops window and brief maintenance. I'll flag priority P2 to get it in this cycle.
sre_bot: INFRA-8723 created by eng_oncall — assignee: infra_team — priority: P2 — link: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-8723
Josh (sales): I'll tell Acme we can run a 48h alias lab free to validate, then discuss long-term replication pricing.
Anna S: Perfect. Please confirm when INFRA-8723 has an exact ETA. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
